body.title: Servicem8 claude agent
body.aiReason: The job needs Claude AI integration with ServiceM8, API work, and automation—fits AI/ML and automation skills, but focuses on chatbot/agent setup rather than data analysis/visualization. Still aligns with core AI/ML expertise.
body.description: Hi Evan, I am looking to set up a Claude operations manager/agent for my electrical business. I would like it to integrate with my servicem8 job management software, so it can automatically read notes from jobs and possibly draft quotes etc. I would like to train all of my business operating procedures to Claude and give access to all of my employees so that they can ask it questions instead of me.
